label: Concept Summarization
description: Does the tutor recap the key points of each newly explained concept?

scale_items.2: Summarizes all or some concepts vaguely.
scale_items.3: Summarizes every newly explained concept clearly.

guidance: Does the tutor recap the key points of each newly explained concept?

label: Information Load Appropriateness
description: Is the amount of information provided appropriate?

scale_items.3: Provides the right amount of information.

guidance: Is the amount of information provided appropriate?

label: Relevance
description: Is the information relevant to the core learning topic, with appropriate connections made when tangential?
guidance: Is the information relevant to the core learning topic, with appropriate connections made when tangential?

label: Real-World Connection and Usefulness
description: Does the tutor explain how the learning topic relates to real-world situations or serves a practical purpose?

scale_items.1: Provides no meaningful connection or practical use.
scale_items.2: Mentions a real-world connection or use without fully explaining it.
scale_items.3: Clearly explains a real-world connection or practical use.

guidance: Does the tutor explain how the learning topic relates to real-world situations or serves a practical purpose?

label: Appropriateness for the Learner’s Level
description: Is the information appropriate for a high-school student?

scale_items.3: All information is appropriate for the learner’s level.

guidance: Is the information appropriate for a high-school student?

label: Opportunities to Demonstrate Understanding
description: Does the tutor provide opportunities for the learner to practise or demonstrate understanding of the core concept?

scale_items.2: Only asks whether the learner has understood.
scale_items.3: Provides a concrete question or follow-up learning task.

guidance: Does the tutor provide opportunities for the learner to practise or demonstrate understanding of the core concept?

label: Conversational Naturalness
description: Does the tutor use familiar conversational phrases and address the learner personally, making the exchange feel like a dialogue?

scale_items.2: Uses some conversational phrases but mostly delivers explanations.
scale_items.3: Feels natural, like talking to a human being.

guidance: Does the tutor use familiar conversational phrases and address the learner personally, making the exchange feel like a dialogue?

label: Positivity of Tone
description: How much warmth, encouragement, or empathy does the tutor express toward the learner?

scale_items.1: Shows little or no warmth or encouragement.
scale_items.2: Shows some warmth or encouragement but is mostly matter-of-fact.
scale_items.3: Consistently conveys a positive and supportive tone.

guidance: How much warmth, encouragement, or empathy does the tutor express toward the learner?

label: Coherence
description: Do the tutor’s explanations and examples build logically on previous turns?

scale_items.1: Makes little or no connection to previous turns.
scale_items.2: Makes some connections, but with room for improvement.

guidance: Do the tutor’s explanations and examples build logically on previous turns?

label: Responsiveness
description: Does the tutor address the learner’s questions, requests, and confusion, and adapt to their knowledge, misconceptions, or interests?

scale_items.2: Acknowledges the learner’s needs but adapts little.
scale_items.3: Responds well and adapts to the learner’s needs.

guidance: Does the tutor address the learner’s questions, requests, and confusion, and adapt to their knowledge, misconceptions, or interests?
